funds.plain_language_explanation: Relief estimate of ₹832,500.00 (0.0833 Crores) is strictly grounded in Ministry of Home Affairs statutory SDRF schedules. It accounts for 6 verified damaged housing structures detected via aerial computer vision, 45.0 hectares of inundated agricultural cropland, and immediate subsistence assistance for 18 displaced families.
audit_notes: All unit rates reflect official Government of India SDRF/NDRF Gazette notifications.
No black-box ML weights were used for currency valuation; values are deterministic.
Requires physical on-ground verification by District Revenue Officer before disbursement.
